name: Belfast Wards 1973 (Raster)

references.label: Local Government Boundaries Commission for Northern Ireland: Provisional Recommendations (1971)
references.note: Provisional stage of the review under the Local Government (Boundaries) Act (Northern Ireland) 1971, with proposed district and ward names and electors; final recommendations followed in 1972. Printed report (HMSO); no online copy found.

references.label: Local Government (Boundaries) Order (Northern Ireland) 1972 (S.R. & O. 1972 No. 131)
references.note: Made 20 Jun 1972, in force 17 Jul 1972; gives effect without modification to the recommendations the Local Government Boundaries Commissioner submitted on 25 Apr 1972 under section 4 of the Local Government (Boundaries) Act (Northern Ireland) 1971. Schedule 2 lists each district's wards by townland. The districts took up their functions after the 1973 local elections.
